name: io.github.paylod/mcp
description: MCP server for paylod — let AI agents transact M-Pesa (STK push, payment status, balance, QR, error decoding, sandbox simulation) through the paylod BaaS.

environmentVariables.name: PAYLOD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Merchant API key (mp_live_... or mp_test_...). Get one from https://paylod.dev.

environmentVariables.name: PAYLOD_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the edge functions base URL (default https://paylod.dev/functions/v1).

environmentVariables.name: PAYLOD_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma list of tool names/categories, or 'all' / 'default'. Money-moving tools (collect, payout, reversal, mint) are opt-in.

environmentVariables.name: PAYLOD_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Supabase session JWT for the sandbox simulate_* tools and mint_api_key (dashboard-session authed).
